ostrzezenia.tekst: The Chutneys section of the NCHFP website lists four recipes: Apple, Mango, Tomato-Apple and Cranberry Orange Chutney.
If the chutney contains onion: the FDA list gives white onions a pH of about 5.37–5.85.
Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods have a pH above 4.6 unless the recipe contains enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar.

akapity: Peach chutney with ginger is not one of these four recipes.
The FDA list gives peaches a pH of about 3.30–4.05.
The whole product needs a minimum, uniform level of acid to prevent the growth of botulism bacteria.
JarAtlas has found no tested recipe for peach chutney with ginger from a checked source.
